rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for studying or investigating a subject, including both careful inquiry and extensive research.

example.english: I need to research how to make this dish.
example.traditional: 我而家要研究下點樣整呢個菜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 jin4 gau3 haa5 dim2 joeng6 zing2 ni1 go3 coi3

rows.note: Use this for a systematic investigation or fact-finding exercise rather than general study of a subject.

example.english: The company set up a team to research the cause of the accident.
example.traditional: 公司成立小組調查事故原因。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 sing4 laap6 siu2 zou2 diu6 caa4 si6 gu3 jyun4 jan1

rows.note: Use this when actively looking into something or seeking information, especially by checking possible leads.

example.english: We need to research this lead before we act.
example.traditional: 我哋要查探清楚呢條線索先至行動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 caa4 taam3 cing1 co2 ni1 tiu4 sin3 sok3 sin1 zi3 hang4 dung6
